flee_battle.description: Generates the button press sequence to select the RUN option from the default battle fight menu (Down, Right, A).

autopress_buttons.description: If true, the generated buttons will be pressed automatically.

flee_battle.python_script:
import json
# Fleeing from battle in Gen 1 is simple: we are on the main battle menu,
# and we need to navigate to the bottom-right option 'RUN'.
# The main battle menu is:
# [FIGHT]  [PKMN ]
# [ITEM ]  [RUN  ]
# To get to 'RUN' from the top-left 'FIGHT' (default cursor position),
# we must press 'Down' once (moves to ITEM) then 'Right' once (moves to RUN), or vice versa.
# Then press 'A' to execute the run command.
# Let's print the buttons as a JSON array.
buttons = ["Down", "Right", "A"]
print(json.dumps(buttons))
